fact: Decryptage reports that UNHCR and the Beninese authorities are working on the biometric integration of displaced people into the national register of natural persons (RNPP), with SP-CNRA annexes opened at Natitingou and Kandi, while 16,463 recognised refugees lack valid ID cards and about 12,400 asylum-seekers await formal registration.
UNHCR's RIMAP page says the National Commission for Refugees and Stateless Persons (SP-CNRA) oversees the registration process, which is currently being piloted in the north-western regions.
